environment: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4770HQ CPU @ 2.20GHz (4 physical cores), x86_64, macOS 14.8.9; CPU only. labstock environment served over MCP stdio. Results apply to this hardware.

items.detail: Over k = 1..5 and per-step error p in {0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20}, 20 trials per task. Largest |z| 1.72; a value below 3.0 is consistent with the analytic pass^k. Calibrates the tool, not a model.
items.label: E1 estimator, max absolute error of pass^k

items.detail: Gate k=3, max_drop=0.1; 200 A/A and 200 A/B pairs at 5 trials per task. Calibrates the tool, not a model.
items.label: E2 gate calibration: false-alarm rate and power

quickstart: uv tool install git+https://github.com/aayushkrm/passk && passk demo
tagline: pass^k for tool-using agents: an offline, CI-gated reliability harness that measures whether an agent succeeds every time, not just once.
